FLOOR AREA 90 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo Lido! This exclusive newly built three-room apartment is located on the fifth floor of the prestigious W-ONE residence, in the heart of Jesolo Lido. Characterized by maximum efficiency with an Energy Class A4 rating, this property (Unit U20) offers perfectly optimized spaces consisting of a bright open-plan living area, two cozy bedrooms, two meticulously finished bathrooms, and a beautiful livable terrace. The property also includes a private parking space and a reserved beach spot. - The Spaces of the Three-Room Apartment and the Livable Terrace The living area stands out for its extraordinary brightness and harmoniously merges with the large livable terrace, creating the ideal environment for outdoor dinners and moments of pure relaxation. The sleeping area consists of two comfortable bedrooms and two contemporary designed bathrooms, crafted to ensure maximum daily functionality within a refined modern style. - Exclusive Services of the Residence Living in W-ONE means accessing a superior comfort experience. Outside there is a spacious communal pool perfect for summer days, while inside there is an equipped gym accessible 24/7. The private parking space and reserved beach spot guarantee you can enjoy the summer season in total privacy and convenience, with the sea just steps away from home. - Benefits and Purchase Services The investment becomes even more advantageous thanks to Sisma Bonus Acquisti; the proposed price has already been calculated net of tax benefits. For those who want a tailored solution, our interior designers are available to define materials and finishes that customize your home according to your style. Additionally, if you need to sell your current property, we manage all aspects of trade-in by enhancing your real estate value so that transitioning into your new home is simple and worry-free. Live by the sea directly at home!
